_comment: Project settings read by tools/check.py and by the agent skills. Keys starting with '_' are comments. See docs/customization.md.
_artifact_language: Language of the prose agents write in artifacts (requirements, questions, specs). Structural labels (headings, frontmatter keys, statuses, field names) stay English so the checker can read them.
_feature_id_pattern: Feature IDs, e.g. a tracker key: PAY-42, LIB-1.
_scope: Labels of the Scope column. 'in' - we write specs for it; 'out' - requirements to systems owned by others, kept for traceability only.
_requirement_types: FR - functional, NFR - non-functional, BR - business rule, IR - integration.
_unit_types: Spec unit types in numbering order. Each type needs templates/spec/<type>.md; its '## ' headings are the required sections.
_api_response_required_keys: Top-level keys every JSON response example of an api-method must contain, e.g. ["data", "error"] for a house response envelope. Empty - no check.

style._style: Optional house style, reported as warnings. Example: {"forbidden_chars": {"\u2014": "use '-'"}, "forbidden_words": {"customer": "say 'user'"}}
